title: Flux Cup
description: A reimagined disposable polymer cup designed to improve usability and sustainability.
overview: Flux Cup is a redesign exercise focused on improving an everyday disposable cup through intentional geometry, material considerations, and user-centered testing.
role: Product design, CAD, analysis, and presentation
outcome: Delivered a refined concept, design calculations, CAD model, and presentation documenting the design process.
highlights: Framed the project around the friction points of a familiar object.
Balanced spill resistance, usability, and material efficiency.
Documented the concept with calculations and a complete CAD model.

title: Swarm Sense
description: Using rainfall measurements and field data to identify likely mosquito breeding grounds.
overview: Swarm Sense explored how environmental datasets can help make mosquito-breeding risk easier to identify and act on.
role: Data exploration, challenge research, and team prototyping
outcome: Created a data-informed concept for translating rainfall and field data into actionable location insights.
highlights: Connected multiple environmental signals to a concrete public-health question.
Worked quickly to turn research into a clear project direction.
Communicated the result through a simple, accessible concept.

title: Canvas Pets
description: A Chrome extension that turns assignment completion into a motivating experience for K–8 students.
overview: Canvas Pets is a Chrome extension that makes progress visible and playful. Students complete assignments, care for a digital companion, and build momentum through small rewards.
role: Hackathon team member · product concept and extension development
outcome: Built a working Chrome-extension concept during SwampHacks XI, with a playful visual system and student-centered motivation loop.
highlights: Designed for a K–8 audience with clear, encouraging interactions.
Connected assignment completion to a simple game loop.
Created custom pixel-art companions and interface assets.

title: Medlog
description: A medical-transcription and sharing platform built during my first hackathon.
overview: Medlog is a concept for reducing the friction of recording, organizing, and sharing medical information across appointments and care teams.
role: Hackathon team member · concept development and prototyping
outcome: Produced a cohesive platform concept and presentation during the DTE Designathon 2025.
highlights: Focused on a sensitive, real-world information-management problem.
Developed a clear product narrative under a short deadline.
Presented a complete concept with supporting research and visuals.
